meta.name: fastapi-expert
meta.description: Use when building high-performance async Python APIs with FastAPI and Pydantic V2. Invoke to create REST endpoints, define Pydantic models, implement authentication flows, set up async SQLAlchemy database operations, add JWT authentication, build WebSocket endpoints, or generate OpenAPI documentation. Trigger terms: FastAPI, Pydantic, async Python, Python API, REST API Python, SQLAlchemy async, JWT authentication, OpenAPI, Swagger Python.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建高性能异步 Python API
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用 Python 构建高性能 API。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build Python backends and want fast async APIs.

howto.what: Claude 会输出 FastAPI 项目代码：给出 Pydantic V2 模型、路由端点、CRUD 操作和 JWT 认证片段，并附带关键决策说明；写完每组端点会提示运行 pytest 并核对 /docs 文档。
howto.when: 当你提到 FastAPI、Pydantic、async Python 等触发词，或要求创建 REST 端点、设置异步数据库、实现认证等任务时，该技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我用 FastAPI 写一个用户注册接口，带 Pydantic 校验。
say.note: 会产出 schema、路由和 CRUD 代码。

say.text: 给项目加上 JWT 登录认证和权限校验。
say.note: 会生成 token 逻辑和依赖注入。

say.text: 用 async SQLAlchemy 写异步查询，并配 pytest 测试。
say.note: 会按 pytest-asyncio 编写测试并验证。

howto.what_en: Claude outputs FastAPI project code: Pydantic V2 models, route endpoints, CRUD operations, JWT auth snippets, plus explanations of key decisions. After each endpoint group, it suggests running pytest and checking /docs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention FastAPI, Pydantic, async Python, or ask to create REST endpoints, set up async databases, implement JWT auth, build WebSockets, or generate OpenAPI docs.

say_en.text: Write a user registration endpoint with FastAPI and Pydantic validation.
say_en.note: Generates schema, router, and CRUD code.

say_en.text: Add JWT login authentication to this project.
say_en.note: Adds token logic and dependency injection.

say_en.text: Use async SQLAlchemy for DB queries and write pytest tests.
